Great relative strength in the daily bull flag which is playing out as a weekly three bar play. Over 142.25 area should open the door for a larger weekly breakout up towards the 154 area.

CENX – Daily / Quarterly

Double bottom daily reversal hover the moving average stack. If it can break the weekly resistance level at 153, room to run into the prior pivot highs towards 161. Not interested if this cant hold the neckline area around 148.25.

If there is going to be a more defensive rally in the market, this could be the chart to end out the year. Multi month range breaking out into the end of last week. Looking for sustained holds over 105.25 for moves over 109.15 to keep all time highs in play.
